description: Companion to valid-tiers.json (ADR-0003). One valid presidio-hardened/evidence-ref@2 envelope carrying one ref per explicit assurance_tier value (attested, optimistic, zk). Every ref reuses the @1 golden content_hash/signature verbatim: the signature covers canonical({content_hash, signer}) exactly as in @1, so declaring a tier does not change what is signed. optimistic and zk name an assurance TARGET; fraud-proof and ZK-proof verification are out of scope of this repo (ADR-0003).
